details.name: The Berber Dynasties
details.summary: New historical Berber Feudal landmarks: Ribat of the Sanhaja and Funduq of Sijilmasa.
details.author: hossein81 and marcokistan
details.description: Original fortified ribat and caravanserai models, native owner-colour flags, explicit construction stages and native-compatible full-detail geometry. Three editable source LODs are included separately; native lower-LOD switching is unsupported. Existing gameplay and accepted assets preserved.
details.changelog: Replace two Feudal landmark visuals with original historical reconstructions.
